does: Scores for the AI one AI-grid tile of a surface: the statuses the tile's surface would apply to whoever stands on it, and interesting items there.

evidence.says: checks esv::StatusMachine::HasStatus and HasActiveStatus for characters and items on the tile, calls IsItemInteresting
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, from 3 places, all in CalculateAiScoreSurface
EoCServer.dll exports this name; the symbol database finds the export again in the executable at this function by the text constants both refer to
